headline: Royal Warship Vasa Founders and Sinks in Stockholm Harbor on Maiden Voyage
dispatch: The pride of the Swedish fleet, the warship Vasa, went to the bottom of Stockholm Harbor on Saturday only minutes after setting sail on her maiden voyage. A gust of wind caught the vessel as she cleared the shelter of the castle walls and she heeled sharply, water pouring through her open lower gun-ports. Witnesses on shore watched helplessly as the great ship capsized and sank, taking dozens of her crew with her into the cold harbor depths.
answer: Swedish warship Vasa sinks on her maiden voyage, 1628
